title: Azure Pipelines: stages, jobs, templates and environments

videos.script: The deploy worked. That is where this course begins. {{deploy}} After the deploy comes everything else. A pipeline that ships the next change. A query that says the shop is slow before a customer does. A secret nobody should read, and a bill at the end of the month. {{course}} You will practise on your own computer. Azurite answers like Azure Storage. A Kusto emulator answers the query language Azure Monitor speaks. Bicep and Terraform check what you describe. {{lab}} None of them is Azure. There is no subscription, and nothing is billed. Where the lab cannot show something, the lesson says so and teaches it from Microsoft's documentation. {{honest}} This first lesson checks the lab, then reads the file that delivers code: an Azure Pipelines definition. {{yaml}} By the end, you can read a pipeline as stages, jobs and steps, and say which part runs where. {{end}}
